items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What would you like to turn off your name if you like, Arch?

ctx.x: What would you like to turn off your name if you like, Arch?
Well, my name is Arthur Frank Hazel. I was born in Harvey, Louisiana. That's just across from Louisiana Avenue in New Orleans.
